subject: Payment Setup: onboarding checklist + one-time PO tokenization

Cc: laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup / PO requirements for upcoming project

Hi Marcus,

We are getting the purchase order together for the pilot (estimated start Nov 1). Before we submit PO, finance needs to complete vendor onboarding for Redwood so payments can flow through our AP system. Two quick asks:

1) Can you send the vendor onboarding packet and a preferred remit/banking instruction set? We need your legal name, TIN, remit address, and bank wiring instructions.
2) Our AP team requires either a US W-9 or (if non-US) VAT registration docs — can you confirm which applies and attach the form?

Also — do you support applying a one-time PO token (so the PO number from this project can be auto-applied to invoices)? If so, our portal needs a vendor token value we can persist.

Attaching: none (we don't yet have Redwood on file).

Thanks,
Samantha Ortiz
Senior AP Manager

Hi Samantha — thanks for the heads up and the timeline. Glad to get this moving. Please find our standard vendor onboarding packet attached (redwood_vendor_onboarding_packet.xlsx) and a filled W-9 (redwood_w9_filled.pdf). Quick notes and asks so your AP can finish the profile in one pass: 

- Legal entity name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Tax ID (TIN): 12-3456789 (W-9 attached)
- Remit address: 420 Lantern Way, San Francisco, CA 94107
- Preferred payment: ACH (bank details included on secure portal or we can send via secure file transfer).
- Invoice naming convention we prefer: RedwoodInvoice_<PO>_<INV#> (example: RedwoodInvoice_PEG-2026-7891_INV1234.pdf).

One-time PO tokenization: we support this. If you can provide the PO value you plan to issue, we can register a vendor token on our side so your portal can auto-match. Suggested token format: PEG-2026-<sequence>. If you want us to create and return a token, tell us which PO number(s) to map.

Laura (Finance) and Neha (Payments) are looped in for invoice acceptance rules and to confirm bank routing approach.

Attachments: redwood_vendor_onboarding_packet.xlsx; redwood_w9_filled.pdf

Next steps: if you confirm the PO number(s) and whether you want us to host the banking details in your secure vendor portal or send them to you via DocuSign/secure link, we'll complete the registration and return the token within 24 business hours.

Best,
Marcus Lin

On Mon, Oct 19, 2026 at 9:12 AM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com> wrote:
> Marcus: please find our packet attached.

Hi Samantha — quick clarifications from finance to avoid payment delays: 

Required fields (must appear on every invoice):
- Redwood Inference, Inc. (legal name)
- Invoice number (unique)
- Invoice date
- PO number (your PEG ID)
- Invoice total and line-level amounts (if applicable)
- Remit to: Redwood Inference, Inc., 420 Lantern Way, San Francisco, CA 94107
- Tax ID: 12-3456789

Preferred extras (not blocking):
- GL code field (optional)
- Contact email for remittance: ap.payments@redwood-inference.com

Payment terms: Net 30 per our standard MSA. If your procurement flow requires invoice approval without a PO, we can accept via pre-approved invoice exceptions but those require a separate ticket and will add ~7 business days to processing.

Invoice submission format: PDF preferred (searchable), file size < 10MB. File name example: redwoodinvoice_PEG-2026-7891_INV1234.pdf

For the bank wiring/ACH details, we prefer to transmit via the customer portal encrypted or by DocuSign secure form (link shared below). Please let us know which method Pegasus prefers.

I've attached a simple invoice template (redwood_invoice_template.pdf) to make sure fields line up with your portal mapping.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Manager, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com

Attachments: redwood_invoice_template.pdf
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@pegasus-analytics.com>

Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700

Thanks Marcus and Laura — good details. We went ahead and created Redwood in our vendor portal this morning. Attached is a confirmation screenshot (pegasus_vendor_confirmation.png).

PO for the pilot: PEG-2026-7891 (I'll be issuing that on Oct 22). Please map that to the token so invoices with that PO auto-match.

For banking details, our security policy requires the supplier to either: (a) upload banking docs directly to our vendor portal under the vendor profile, or (b) complete our DocuSign secure remittance form. Option (a) is preferred. If you can upload the ACH file to: https://vendors.pegasus-analytics.com/secure-upload/redwood-inference (we can enable a one-time upload link) we'll use that.

Tax: W-9 looks good. We also need confirmation whether any services will be performed from EU jurisdictions (VAT implications). If yes, please send VAT registration docs.

I'll proceed with creating the PO and notify you when it's approved.

Best,
